catalog.name: GitHub Rapid Analyzer
catalog.description: Fetch commit/PR/diff/check facts and focus bounded regression or integrity review.
catalog.excerpt: Fetch authoritative facts first. Jev prioritizes semantic review focus; it cannot invent permissions, CI, deployment success or runtime behavior.

catalog.name: Google Drive Rapid Analyzer
catalog.description: Read file metadata, revisions and bounded content to resolve Drive/GitHub provenance or version gaps.
catalog.excerpt: Read Drive facts first. Verify state changes through metadata/content/revision readback; private payloads do not move into public folders.

catalog.name: Cloud environment runtime
catalog.description: Inspect current environment connectivity, credential readiness and network-secret bindings without printing values.
catalog.excerpt: Require current observations and an individual ready state before assuming a binding works. Preserve proxy and CA trust. Configuration uses the supported environment workflow.

catalog.name: Plugin management
catalog.description: Find an existing provider integration or determine whether a missing plugin is available.
catalog.excerpt: Prefer built-in or connected capabilities before new plugins. Search before claiming an external service unavailable; this turn TypeSafe Jev search returned no plugin.

catalog.name: Official TypeSafe agent skill
catalog.description: External pinned provider guidance for narrow typed judgments and code-owned workflows; not installed here.
catalog.excerpt: Reference inspected at pinned commit. Source existence is not installation, execution, authentication or R3 adoption evidence.

catalog.name: Google Drive file lifecycle
catalog.description: Upload approved private archives, inspect sharing metadata, download exact bytes and verify remote state without sharing links.
catalog.excerpt: Ground folder and file IDs from search/metadata. Preserve sharing. Stored files use authenticated raw fetch; verify actual bytes and postconditions after upload.

catalog.name: Full-story verification
catalog.description: Check the complete task flow across authentication, API, stored data and final result; apply to backup upload/download/restore.
catalog.excerpt: Infer the user story, collect evidence at each boundary, walk the flow, verify postconditions and preserve limits. Here the story is executor archive to private Drive storage to authenticated download to isolated restore.

catalog.name: Current official Codex plugin examples
catalog.description: Pinned official OpenAI plugin catalog reference for future skill packaging; not installed or required for current backup.
catalog.excerpt: Current repository catalogs plugin examples with manifests and optional skills, apps and MCP surfaces. The earlier openai/skills README redirects here. Reference inspection does not establish installation or access.

state.scope: Recommend skills only; do not claim web search, install tools, authorize a deploy, activate RRR or certify backup completeness.
